items.headline: Miller, Ison lead ground game and Toledo slips past Sacramento State 20-17
items.description: — CJ Miller ran for 135 yards, Autavius Ison had 101 yards and a touchdown, and Toledo defeated Sacramento State 20-17 on Wednesday night.

items.description: Kickers came through in the clutch in Week 9, and elsewhere, Miami, Utah and UCLA all stayed undefeated.

items.headline: Isaiah Ene helps Sacramento State beat Kent State 31-10 for first MAC win
items.description: — Freshman Isaiah Ene had a career-high 107 yards rushing and two touchdowns on 19 carries, Donovan Turner returned an interception 36-yards for a score and Sacramento State beat Kent State on Friday night to win its first Mid-American Conference game.
